scope: Qwen3-8B ROM die r17b (823.78 mm2): tools/qwen_rom_fulldie_b3r2.py selected() with the r17b recipe on claude/qwen-die-rebuild-20261005 @ f76c3603b (not on main; linted through the --qwen-ref overlay on main 4f7fe01f339b); the generated netlist is byte-identical to the r17b_real case die.v (sha256 86a9e54b...). First lint of the Qwen die.
method: tools/die_top_lint.py lint --die qwen_rom --qwen-ref f76c3603b: real blocks bound by their ports (ot_hbm3e_phy black box, qfd_cdc -> ot_qwen_stream4_cdc_pc RTL, bundles in the generator order of _cdc_arg); every other master a port-identical registered stub; DIRECTION MODEL dirs_qwen (endpoint 0 upstream, links 528/528, corridor / tap / head chain with one ready bit back)

result.connectivity: no undriven, multi-driven, floating, unloaded or width-truncated net bit; no duplicate port binding; no replicated copy missing pins (unlike S81 S1-S4 and HBM H1-H4)

findings.block: qfd_cdc (128, bound to ot_qwen_stream4_cdc_pc RTL ports)
findings.cls: clock / reset: real RTL clock and reset pins with no die net
findings.evidence: unbound_real_pins: 4 pins x 128 instances; Verilator PINMISSING 512
findings.fix: per-PC CDC frame: core clock from the strip region clock, HCLK from the HBM clock (976.6 MHz) of its stack, both resets; add ck/hck/rst pins to the qfd_cdc abstract

findings.port_or_net: no HBM clock net; PHY clk / rst_n
findings.cls: clock: the HBM domain has no clock source or net
findings.evidence: clocking: qfd_ctrl NO_CLOCK; the PHY black box clk / rst_n are bits 0/1 of the 9,209-b dfi bundle driven by the placeholder qfd_ctrl; no clock_trunk reaches the strip controllers
findings.fix: HBM PLL / clock entry per stack (or from the PHY) and a clock pin on qfd_ctrl; bind PHY clk / rst_n to it, not to the dfi bundle

findings.cls: clock: most blocks have no clock net
findings.evidence: clock_trunk reaches only hub_el, io_collective (PLL), 4 x qfd_lfifo and sp_su64_sfu. NO_CLOCK: 24 qfd_reng, 32 link stations (qfd_lst_*), 16 band port slabs, sp_tree_top, sp_constants_sequencer (holds the CLOSED ot_qwen_rom_core), io_embedding_rom, io_ucie, io_serdes
findings.fix: one stream clock net per decision-C clock region (120 regions in m[clock_regions]) from the hub root, a serial-domain net for the 0.9 GHz blocks, and a ck pin on every master that holds flops

findings.block: tile field (1,536 qfd_tile, 1,536 qfd_cst, 64 qfd_chead) and sp_vector_memory
findings.port_or_net: clock / reset bits inside the corridor (388 b), tap (325 b) and head-chain words
findings.cls: clock: field clock has no source
findings.evidence: the field clock and reset ride as data bits of the corridor / tap words, whose root is sp_vector_memory (serial 0.9 GHz domain, itself on no clock net); the region-CTS vehicle (qwen_rom_die_region_cts.py) builds a CTS tree per 4 x 4-tile block that the die netlist does not contain
findings.fix: feed each decision-C tile-block region clock from the hub clock root (a clock_trunk per region) and take the clock / reset bits out of the corridor word, or state that the corridor clock bits ARE the region tree and give them a stream-domain source

findings.cls: meso / ratio FIFO gap: clock-domain crossings with no FIFO
findings.evidence: clock_domain_crossings: crom_a/crom_q (SU64 0.9 <-> sequencer 1.2, 5,696 b), seq_ib/seq_su/seq_coll/seq_sud (942 b), x3 / attn_ret (1,024 b), head_31/32 (VM 0.9 -> column heads 1.2, 776 b), emb (512 b), kvn_* (strip 1.2 -> controller 976.6 MHz, 4 x 128 b, NOT covered by the STREAM4 CDC), ucie_tx / serdes_tx (0.9 -> link domains). Only the 128 hbm_cdc buses end in a CDC element. Decision C names 3 ratio FIFOs (X1/X2/X3, ot_ratio_cdc_fifo 3:4); none is instantiated
findings.fix: instantiate ot_ratio_cdc_fifo (3:4) at each serial/stream crossing, an async FIFO on kvn_*, and the link-side CDC in the collective; or move crom / sequencer into one domain

findings.block: qfd_lst_* (32 link stations) and FIFO slots
findings.evidence: 32 link stations = 416 ot_fwd_link_stage W512 slices (152,064 stage bits), 0 instantiated, no forwarded-clock pin; decision-C FIFO slots exist only as AREA: 1,536 tile-tap (2,036 b), 96 block-word (2,048 b), 4 strip-return (2,176 b), 0 FIFO instances or FIFO ports in the netlist
findings.fix: as S12 on the S81 die: stage/FIFO instances (or hardened station / slab masters that contain them) with wclk/rclk pins

findings.cls: placed block that was DROPPED physically
findings.evidence: results/uarch/qwen_nearhbm_attn_rtl_20261003/pnr/retry_20261004/verdict.json: verdict DROP (hub post-CTS SS -88.95 ps; row engines never closed); r17b still places 24 row-engine frames (328.3 x 1,998 um) and the combine hub; the hub is also the die clock root
findings.fix: owner decision: replace by the closed alternative (KV path without near-HBM attention) or re-open the block; the die area / wire pricing of r17b assumes it

findings.cls: role-dependent master: one master whose ports change direction by instance
findings.evidence: placeholder_port_direction_conflicts: qfd_cst.a/b, qfd_chead.e/w, qfd_lst_h.e/w, qfd_reng.fn/fs each have 2 direction signatures (north vs south corridor half, W vs E channel, strip order); mirroring fixes geometry only
findings.fix: two hardened masters per family (N/S or W/E flow) or direction-free pin naming (in/out ports assigned per flow, the abstract mirrored)

findings.cls: block shape: source with no input
findings.evidence: block_shape: 0 input bits; no token-id / address net reaches the embedding ROM (ot_qwen_rt_embed_rom has an address input)
findings.fix: address / valid bus from the sequencer or VM to the embedding ROM

findings.port_or_net: bw0..bw5 in (3,072 b), md out (2 b)
findings.cls: block shape: data sink (ME results never leave the tree top)
findings.evidence: block_shape: 3,072 b in, only the 2-b ME-done status out; no result word from the tree top to SU64 / VM / hub
findings.fix: result word (>= 512 b) from sp_tree_top to the vector memory / SU64 X path

findings.cls: link interface: no hard IP view; direction not stated
findings.evidence: reservation blocks with no RTL and no LEF (the S81 die uses the ot_pdie_ucie / ot_pdie_serdes pin macros); the one bus per link is named *_tx: this lint assumes 512 tx + 512 rx (as the S81 links); TX-only would leave the die with no collective receive path
findings.fix: bind the link reservations to ot_pdie_ucie / ot_pdie_serdes (tx[511:0] / rx[511:0]) and name both directions

findings.cls: compute abutting the hub / spine without a channel
findings.evidence: abut: 29 E-array column-32 tile / slab pairs touch the spine slabs (port fragments _f*, constants_sequencer) at 0.024 um, and 57 row-23 tile / IO-block pairs touch the IO band (collective, embedding ROM, UCIe, SerDes) at 0.024 um; the W side has the 52.7 um corridor / station column (s_31_* abut the spine at 0.024 um). r17b passes GRT i5 / pin access, so this is a margin, not a failure; b3r14 --edge-gap exists but is off
findings.fix: keep, or give the E array the same one-corridor gap as the W array (b3r14 edge gap) when M8/M9 congestion at the spine faces returns in r17c/d

findings.cls: pin faces away from the peer
findings.evidence: hub x3 / ar on the W face, SU64 q and VM ar on the E face (peers 412 um behind each face); VM em on the S face while the embedding ROM is 16.7 mm north in the IO band; hub lsw on W face, its waypoint 477 um behind
findings.fix: move VM em to the N face; hub x3 / ar and SU64 q / VM ar on facing (N/S) faces

findings.cls: abstract ports with no die net
findings.evidence: abstract_ports_without_net: hub ls (superseded by lsw/lse after the b3 south split); 23 block-word ports on three fragment slabs
findings.fix: drop the dead ports from the abstracts (they become dead pins in a hardened view)

findings.port_or_net: 32 PCs over 6 row engines per stack
findings.evidence: 2 engines per stack take 6 PCs, 4 take 5 (c5 unbound on 16 of 24; Verilator PINMISSING); the per-engine HBM read demand differs by 20 %
findings.fix: only matters if the row engine is kept (Q7)
